name: Jewel Shop
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Shop is a girl game where you’re the boss of your own jewelry shop. Play as a businesswoman who is manning her own shop that sells beautiful jewelry. There gold and silver rings, earrings, and necklaces that you are selling! Each customer has their own choice in jewelry and some of them are on a time-crunch. Sometimes you run out and must order more which can lead to an angry customer. Play quickly to fulfill each request before the customer gets upset and leaves. Earn a good enough for your score within the allotted time to advance to the next level. There are 10 levels of this cute time-management game for you to play! Once you have completed all 10 levels, submit your score and check to see if you’re in the high scoreboard.
